powerSeries = [0] * 18
powerSeries[1] = 1
for i in range(2, 18):
    powerSeries[i] = powerSeries[i - 1] * 10 + 1

def computeCost(val, level):
    times = val // powerSeries[level]
    if val % powerSeries[level] == 0:
        return level * times
    cost1 = level * times + computeCost(val % powerSeries[level], level - 1)
    cost2 = level * (times + 1) + computeCost(powerSeries[level] - (val % powerSeries[level]), level - 1)
    return min(cost1, cost2)
